title: Fur Hood & Gold Earrings
prompt: An original young woman in a fluffy beige fur-lined hood wears ornate gold drop earrings and a cream ribbed turtleneck. A tiger-stripe faux-fur collar frames her shoulder. Her expression is serious, with her gaze slightly off to the side. Bright, sunlit sky and a distant hillside behind her. Warm light with film grain, a palette of cream, camel, and gold with deep black accents. Textured and warm, in the style of a film-shot winter editorial.
workingNotes:
- The fur hood and tiger-stripe collar are the texture focus.
- Keep the film grain to match the vintage feel.
